def make_article_info(self):
        """
        The Article Info contains the (self) Citation, Editors, Dates,
        Copyright, Funding Statement, Competing Interests Statement,
        Correspondence, and Footnotes. Maybe more...

        This content follows the Heading and precedes the Main segment in the
        output.

        This function accepts the receiving_node argument, which will receive
        all generated output as new childNodes.
        """
        # The Article Info is a Heading
        self.make_heading(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Citation
        self.make_citation(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Editors
        self.make_editors(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Dates
        self.make_dates(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Copyright
        self.make_copyright(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Funding Statement
        self.make_funding_statement(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Competing Interests Statement
        self.make_competing_interests(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Correspondence
        self.make_correspondence(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)

        # The Article Info contains the Footnotes
        self.make_footnotes(receiving_node=self.article_info_node)
